bugs.name: mobile-nav-fullheight-menu
bugs.description: The mobile hamburger menu does not open a full-height touch panel. The header (<header data-testid="site-header">) has 'backdrop-blur-xl' (backdrop-filter), which creates a new CSS containing block for position:fixed descendants. The mobile nav panel (data-testid="mobile-navigation", classes 'fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 top-[72px] ...') is a child of that header, so its 'bottom-0' resolves against the header's own ~72px box instead of the viewport. Result: the panel renders as a ~49px sliver just under the header instead of a full-height menu; the nav links (Home/About/Services/etc.) and the 'Start a Project' CTA are not visible or reachable. Confirmed twice (not flaky) with document.body.style.overflow correctly set to 'hidden' (scroll lock works) but bounding box height 48.99px vs expected >600px at 390x844.
bugs.evidence: Screenshot /root/.emergent/automation_output/20260919_055503_441/mobile-nav-fullheight-menu-failure.png shows only a thin dark strip below the header with no visible menu items after clicking mobile-menu-toggle; computed style dump: {top:'72px', bottom:'0px', position:'fixed', height:'49px'} with parentTag HEADER (backdrop-blur-xl ancestor). Backend cross-check: GET http://localhost:8001/api/ -> 200 {"message":"Hello World"}, confirming this is a frontend-only rendering defect, not a backend/data issue. Fix suggestion: move the mobile menu panel outside the blurred header (e.g. render via portal, or apply backdrop-blur to an inner wrapper instead of the header element itself so it isn't the fixed-position containing block).

action_items.item: Fix backdrop-blur-on-header containing-block bug so the mobile nav panel spans full viewport height on mobile.
